relations.quote: Exact recovery by rounding works on the output of the [Synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) run in the opposite direction: its input is the array of approximate coefficients.
Its error is controlled by the single truncation after each [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) in the transforms, so the error must be bounded after all layers.
Exact recovery by rounding inverts the [Signed Kronecker packing](kronecker-packing.md), since carries undo the evaluation at a power of two.

Exact recovery by rounding is based on the normalized cyclic convolution that [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein-chirp.md) produces, so the known normalizations of that convolution must be removed first.
